title: SG-6.2 Second NPC scene unit tests with mocked dependencies
summary: Unit tests load a scene with a second NPC from data and prove validation, spawn, idle animation and invalid-reference rejection
description: Context: characterSchema, validateWorld scene character checks, resolveCharacterAnimation and BootScene.createCharacter already exist, but the only tested character is the boy. Desired behavior: unit tests with every dependency mocked load a scene containing a second NPC from data. Expected result: tests prove it validates, is spawned, resolves its idle animation from the manifest, and that an unknown NPC reference is rejected. Why: guards data-driven NPC support.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with a second NPC whose id is in the world list, when sceneSchema and validateWorld run, then both accept it with no errors
Given a loaded scene with boy and a second NPC, when BootScene.create runs, then two character sprites are created and each plays its own idle animation key
Given the NPC idle ref points to a manifest asset, when resolveCharacterAnimation runs, then it returns that asset and animation
Given a scene NPC id absent from world.characters, when validateWorld runs, then it returns a path-tagged unknown character error

in_scope: New unit tests for the second NPC
Minimal product exports the tests need

technical_constraints: Phaser, fs and content mocked or in-memory
definition_of_done: All requirement tickets have passing Verify units
non_functional: Each test file runs in seconds
